contexts.text: The chiefs of the people () = lower truths such as those in the literal sense.
These chiefs, whom you saw at the head of the tables...
At the tables of those of the first rank in Heaven.
Thus do the leaders of the Church define the word person.
By eagles () are here meant the leaders of the Church, like lynxes.
That similar loves would burst forth from many of the leaders of the Churches outside Babylon, unless their power was limited...
By the chiefs of the people who dug, etc. are signified those who are intelligent and wise from the Lord.
